methodology: Articles sourced from Virginia-specific RSS feeds and Google News RSS, filtered for AI/technology/workforce relevance, then assessed by Claude against the scenario framework. Each article is tagged with the region it most affects and the scenario it signals toward.

signals.title: Stack Infrastructure says it’s moving forward with AI data center in Pittsylvania
signals.signal_reading: Data center infrastructure arriving in Pittsylvania represents concentrated capital investment but not distributed AI capability—Southside gains tax revenue and construction jobs while deep technical expertise remains concentrated in metro hubs that design and manage these facilities remotely.

signals.title: Roanoke College launches WorkAI Lab to prepare leaders for new era of technology - Roanoke College
signals.signal_reading: Roanoke College's WorkAI Lab signals intentional cultivation of deep AI literacy through educational infrastructure in a mid-sized market, creating potential for distributed capability if graduates stay regional rather than migrating to NoVA.

signals.title: Norfolk native brings free AI workshops to Hampton Roads to close the technology gap - WTKR
signals.signal_reading: Free community AI workshops directly address the access gap in Hampton Roads, representing grassroots capability-building that could enable distributed adoption if sustained beyond individual volunteer efforts into institutional support.

signals.title: TAYLOR: AI data centers increase Virginia’s urban-rural divide - The Cavalier Daily
signals.signal_reading: Commentary explicitly naming the urban-rural divide created by data center concentration signals recognition that current infrastructure investments are deepening geographic inequality rather than distributing capability across Virginia's regions.

signals.title: Richmond summer program helps visually impaired students explore careers in technology and cybersecurity - WTVR.com
signals.signal_reading: Targeted technology education for visually impaired students in Richmond demonstrates deep skill-building reaching underserved populations, signaling that distributed capability depends on inclusive access pathways, not just geographic distribution.
